description: Routing eval: prompts never name a skill. 'expect' is one or more alternatives separated by '|'; any alternative passing passes the case. An alternative is one or more conditions joined by '&', all of which must hold: a playbook name (gm invoked and that playbook read, as its file or via check-playbooks --show), 'skill:<name>' (that gmstack skill invoked, directly or via gm), 'show:<name>' (check-playbooks.mjs --show <name> was run), 'say:<regex>' (some assistant text matches, case-insensitive), or 'direct' (no gmstack skill invoked). 'overlay' names a folder under evals/overlays/ copied over the fixture.
